root_cause: bg-bedrijfsprofiel was merged (PR #5058) without a [functions.*] block in supabase/config.toml. The production edge authority gate on main refuses the function and so blocks attest for every edge change.
fix: Declare bg-bedrijfsprofiel with verify_jwt = true. The handler has no own caller authentication and spends Tavily and Anthropic budget with the service role, so public invocation is not acceptable.
prevention_rule: Every edge function in supabase/functions that is deployed must have a [functions.<name>] block with an explicit verify_jwt value.
